label: PrismStation 5AC (PS-5AC)
description: Ubiquiti PrismStation 5AC shielded airMAX ac radio base - one Gigabit Ethernet data port with passive PoE in (24 V, 10 W maximum draw), a 5 GHz 2x2 802.11ac radio with an interchangeable horn antenna and a dedicated 2.4 GHz management radio. Antenna sold separately; GPS sync connector on the housing.
notes: Two things a lab gets wrong here. (1) The antenna is **not** part of the box - the PrismStation is a radio base for an interchangeable horn, so its 5 GHz 'radio' has no integrated gain and a topology that expects a built-in antenna is modelling a different product (LiteAP/NanoBeam). (2) The 2.4 GHz radio is a *management* radio, not a second data channel: it exists to reach the radio when the 5 GHz link is down, so it is declared as `radio1` and should not be used to carry traffic. Per-band rates (867 Mbps on 5 GHz 2x2 802.11ac, 300 Mbps on the 2.4 GHz 802.11n management radio) are class rates - the page quotes real throughput, not PHY rates. Power is passive 24 V PoE in on the single data port at 10 W; there is no PoE out and no second Ethernet port.
